verses.t: O you who wraps himself [in clothing]
verses.pickthall: O thou wrapped up in thy raiment

verses.t: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little
verses.pickthall: Keep vigil the night long, save a little

verses.t: Half of it - or subtract from it a little
verses.pickthall: A half thereof, or abate a little thereof

verses.t: Or add to it, and recite the Qur'an with measured recitation
verses.pickthall: Or add (a little) thereto - and chant the Qur'an in measure

verses.t: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word
verses.pickthall: For we shall charge thee with a word of weight

verses.t: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words
verses.pickthall: Lo! the vigil of the night is (a time) when impression is more keen and speech more certain

verses.t: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation
verses.pickthall: Lo! thou hast by day a chain of business

verses.t: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion
verses.pickthall: So remember the name of thy Lord and devote thyself with a complete devotion

verses.t: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs
verses.pickthall: Lord of the East and the West; there is no Allah save Him; so choose thou Him alone for thy defender

verses.t: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance
verses.pickthall: And bear with patience what they utter, and part from them with a fair leave-taking

verses.t: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little
verses.pickthall: Leave Me to deal with the deniers, lords of ease and comfort (in this life); and do thou respite them awhile

verses.t: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire
verses.pickthall: Lo! with Us are heavy fetters and a raging fire

verses.t: And food that chokes and a painful punishment
verses.pickthall: And food which choketh (the partaker), and a painful doom

verses.t: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down
verses.pickthall: On the day when the earth and the hills rock, and the hills become a heap of running sand

verses.t: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger
verses.pickthall: Lo! We have sent unto you a messenger as witness against you, even as We sent unto Pharaoh a messenger

verses.t: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure
verses.pickthall: But Pharaoh rebelled against the messenger, whereupon We seized him with no gentle grip

verses.t: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white- haired
verses.pickthall: Then how, if ye disbelieve, will ye protect yourselves upon the day which will turn children grey

verses.t: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled
verses.pickthall: The very heaven being then rent asunder. His promise is to be fulfilled

verses.t: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way
verses.pickthall: Lo! This is a Reminder. Let him who will, then, choose a way unto his Lord

verses.t: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful
verses.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord knoweth how thou keepest vigil sometimes nearly two-thirds of the night, or (sometimes) half or a third thereof, as do a party of those with thee. Allah measureth the night and the day. He knoweth that ye count it not, and turneth unto you in mercy. Recite, then, of the Qur'an that which is easy for you. He knoweth that there are sick folk among you, while others travel in the land in search of Allah's bounty, and others (still) are fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite of it that which is easy (for you), and establish worship and pay the poor-due, and (so) lend unto Allah a goodly loan. Whatsoever good ye send before you for your souls, ye will find it with Allah, better and greater in the recompense. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful
